descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S16 Wrong device clock (browser override and real phones), both modes: every retention clock is stamped with server time

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U15 Every retention clock uses the server clock, in both modes: a device with a wrong clock, no clock set or another time zone makes no record clear earlier or later than on any other device. (UAT 3.8; UAT 3.3; TFA-94699 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given One fresh @roundai.test account from freshAccount() on the local stack (Convex 4510, Vite 6473) with the make-session fixture's Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident. Devices: (a) desktop Chrome with the clock set 3 days ahead, 3 days behind, and the time zone Pacific/Kiritimati (UTC+14); …

When On each device, on the Hospital patient: type pre-round text, enter BP 128/76 and HR 82 and press Save Vitals, add Cr 1.2 and press Save Labs, add the Important Point 'QA clock check', hold 'warfarin, held for INR 4.2' in the Medications panel, add the task 'QA clock task' and complete it, type the encounter text 'QA …

Then On every device, each stored clock equals the server time of its save ±2 min: vitalsUpdatedAt, labsUpdatedAt, ptsEditedAt, preRoundEditedAt, medicationsUpdatedAt and the row's updatedAt, tasks[].doneAt, encounterEditedAt, and in the Save Note / Generate run notesProcessedAt and noteGeneratedAt; the same fields on the Nursing Home resident

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.8 ('every time-based rule ... uses the server clock ... a phone with a wrong clock ... shows the same state as any other device'; 'Test with one device set to the wrong date'), 3.3 and TFA-94699 AC 7: a stored clock that follows the device clock (±2-3 days, or shifted by the time zone) = Fail, because that item's window would end at a different time than on a correct dev …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
